notes.title: Update 7313
notes.content:
Hi Bad Guys, here is a KTBG update:

[b]UI:[/b]

- New TitleScreen
- Connection Quality display as Server
- No infinite time
- Improving Chat readability

[b]Bugfix:[/b]

- Money sync
- Safer pos for box & piano desabotage
- Sabotage TreeMulti interactive (as the others)
- People cut members synchronized
- Pathfinder issues fixed (puddles, electricity & money)
- Slots on GasTank
- Ball's slide (for team)
- Pathfinding to slots until they are activated
- Thrower reset

[b]InGame:[/b]

- Music for multiplayer
- Skins

And remember, if you want to test multiplayer, send us an email on ktbg@exkee.com.

notes.title: Gangs of Bad Guys is in closed beta!
notes.content:
[h1]It's time to kill Bad Guys ... again ! The closed multiplayer beta has officially begun ![/h1]

[b]Don't forget to join it in writing us on ktbg@exkee.com.[/b] And you will receive a code and the procedure to follow.

Repaint the streets in bloody red ! Show us how cunning you are, and be the most dangerous of all the Bad Guys !

notes.title: Gangs of Bad Guys : the new multiplayer mode in KTBG universe
notes.content:
[h1]It's official. Kill The Bad Guy will have its [b]MULTIPLAYER[/b] mode : Gangs of Bad Guys.[/h1]
[b]A CLOSED BETA[/b] is coming soon. If you want to be a part of it and join in the gang warfare, write us on ktbg@exkee.com.

You are no more a justicer, this time you are the Bad Guy. You'll have to prove you are the most bad ass and dangerous of them !
Be clever and cunning to achieve your aims, face your opponents, kill them all, and bring the terror in the streets !
It will be bloody, so be prepared or you'll die painfully...

All the informations just here : http://www.ktbg-thegame.com/?p=705

Exkee Team

notes.title: First major update for KTBG!
notes.content:
A new version of KTBG is available (1.1) with a major update for the music of the game.
Samuel Safa has composed 7 new incredible music pieces. Enjoy now a better music experience, varied and perfectly suited to the universe of KTBG.
We have also improved some ergonomics and gameplay items.
Thanks for playing!
